title: WAtimized
description: WAtimized is a lightweight, performance-focused Minecraft modpack based on Fabulously Optimized, enhanced with carefully chosen quality-of-life and exploration mods while preserving a smooth, vanilla-friendly experience.
body:
## WAtimized

### About This Modpack

**WAtimized** is a **personal fork of the Fabulously Optimized modpack**, created to make it easier to share a customized Minecraft experience with friends while keeping the original focus on **performance, stability, and smooth gameplay**.

The core philosophy of Fabulously Optimized remains intact: fast load times, high FPS, OptiFine feature parity, and strong compatibility with vanilla servers and worlds. On top of that foundation, WAptimized adds a **small, carefully selected set of mods** aimed at improving **quality of life and exploration**, without turning the pack into a heavy content modpack or changing core vanilla mechanics.

This pack is intended to stay **lightweight, easy to use, and multiplayer-friendly**, making it suitable for casual play sessions, private servers, or long-term survival worlds.

***

### How This Differs from Fabulously Optimized

Compared to the original Fabulously Optimized modpack, **WAtimized**:

*   Adds a **limited number of quality-of-life mods**
*   Includes **minor exploration enhancements**
*   Introduces optional visual improvements such as shaders and animations

All added mods are chosen with performance, compatibility, and simplicity in mind, and are meant to complement — not replace — the original experience.

***

### Development Status & Future Plans

WAtimized is a **work in progress** and will continue to evolve over time. Planned updates may include:

*   Additional quality-of-life or exploration-focused mods
*   Optional features added only after thorough testing
*   Potential progression or goal-oriented systems

Updates will be gradual to ensure stability and performance remain a priority.

Feedback and suggestions are welcome.
